reviews.name: Akash
reviews.text: recently bought the Crystal Ball Lamp with Wooden LED Base featuring the engraved 3D Moon & Stars design, and I couldn't be happier with my purchase. The lamp adds a beautiful, enchanting ambiance to my room, thanks to its stunning 3D deer engraving that comes to life when lit. The wooden base gives it a rustic charm, making it a stylish home decor piece. It's also USB rechargeable, which is convenient for use anywhere in the house without worrying about cords. This lamp makes a perfect birthday gift for teens, boys, and girls, as it brings a touch of magic to their space. I highly recommend this lamp for anyone looking to brighten their home with a unique and captivating piece
